subject: How to calculate likelihood value at true parameters?

messages.author: 33ffbd5d5e9bca08
messages.subject: How to calculate likelihood value at true parameters?
parts:
Dear all,

After obj<-MakeADFun and opt<-nlminb, I got parameter estimates from sdreport (obj) and log-scaled likelihood value under those estimated parameters
through opt$objective. I am also interested in calculating the likelihood value under the true parameters as well. Do you know how I can get that?

Best,
Jing

messages.author: 395bdca538bcae5d
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] How to calculate likelihood value at true parameters?
parts: Hi Jing, with TMB you can calculate the objective function or gradient for any parameter vector by just passing it to obj$fn(x) where x is your vector (in this case the real values). -Cole
